info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Enterprise Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Service Retrieval API enables users to obtain specific legal advisory services based on a unique parameter. This operation is designed for finance and legal professionals who need to access detailed information regarding available enterprise services. By querying with the parameter provided, consumers can efficiently retrieve relevant service details necessary for decision-making and compliance purposes. This API supports use cases involving legal consultations and enterprise service management.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information regarding the legal advisory service identified by the specified resource ID. It provides all necessary information regarding the service, including guidelines and terms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the legal advisory information for the specified enterprise service. Ensure that the request payload adheres to the defined schema to retrieve accurate data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the legal advisory resource.
